newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Canadian Natural debt rating.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Canadian Natural debt rating.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Friday it confirmed its R-1 (Low) rating with a stable trend on Canadian Natural Resources Ltd's commercial paper.

DBRS said the company's earnings and cash flow were experiencing strong growth in response to rising production as a result of good internally generated reserve replacement rates and its acquisition of Sceptre Resources.
DBRS said Canadian Natural's debt levels were rising because of an aggressive capital and exploration program.
But it did not expect debt to exceed two-times cash flow on a historical basis or the company's internal target of 1.5 times fourth-quarter annualized cash flow.
